Dylan — copied finance ops on this thread (laura included). Quick answers: 
1) Split payments: we support virtual-card plus wire partials on a case-by-case basis. For SignalWave, we can allow up to 50% via virtual card provided the card reference is included on the remittance and the PO number is present. Virtual card fees are the customer's responsibility unless we agree otherwise in writing.
2) Wire posting: wires initiated before 5pm ET generally post same day; since SignalWave is on PT, if they wire before 2pm PT likely posts same day — otherwise next business day. Expect 1 business day slack for reconciliation.
3) Remittance fields: include PO# (778), invoice# (6120), total paid, payment method, and if split — amounts per method. If they attach remittance-advice-6120.pdf it'll speed reconciliation.

I'll also flag this in the AP queue so we can match quickly. Dylan — if they confirm ACH attempt and you think cutoff risk is high, I'll approve a one-off expedited match.
